test_fillna_datetime64: test the fillna method on a DatetimeIndex to replace NaT values with a specified timestamp
test_fillna_tz_mismatch: test fillna on a timezone-aware DatetimeIndex when the replacement value has a mismatched timezone
test_fillna_object_dtype: test fillna on a DatetimeIndex replacing NaT with a non-timestamp value to produce an object-dtype Index
test_fillna_tz_aware_index: test fillna on a timezone-aware DatetimeIndex with a matching timezone replacement timestamp
test_fillna_tz_naive_replacement: test fillna on a timezone-aware DatetimeIndex with a naive timestamp replacement producing object dtype
